infoLinks.urlText: Major Event Buses operating for the Sydney Royal Easter Show
infoLinks.content:
Sydney Olympic Park Major Event Buses will run on all nine routes each day during the Sydney Royal Easter Show from Thursday 2 to Monday 13 April 2026.  
  
Travel on the Major Event Buses is included in the cost of tickets to the Easter Show. No need to tap on and off, simply show your Easter Show ticket to the driver when boarding buses.   
  
Buses run every 10 to 20 minutes from early morning until around 2.30pm each day during the Show. 
  
Please note that timetables vary on weekdays and weekends and are subject to traffic conditions.  
  
Return buses will start leaving Olympic Park from 2pm each day, with the last bus leaving at 10.30pm each night. Additional buses will operate on Friday 3 April for fans attending the NRL game at Accor Stadium and on Thursday 9 April (Seniors Day), return buses start leaving Olympic Park from 1pm. 
  
For more information on transport options to the event including detailed bus timetables, see the Royal Easter Show event page.

urlText: Buses replace trains between Central and Bondi Junction
content:
Saturday 18 and Sunday 19 April
  • Buses replace trains between Central and Bondi Junction, but do not stop at Martin Place.
  • Trains run to a changed timetable between Cronulla, Waterfall and the City Circle, with some making extra stops at St Peters and Erskineville.
  • Change at:
    - Central for buses to Kings Cross and Edgecliff
    - Town Hall for express buses to Bondi Junction.

  • From Martin Place Station, buses leave from nearby bus stops, or you can walk to Wynyard Station for trains to T4 Illawarra Line stations.
  • Metro trackwork may affect how you travel. Metro services do not run between Sydenham and Chatswood.
  • Use train services to continue your journey.
  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes
20T4 Bondi Junction, Edgecliff, Kings Cross, Central and return (bypassing Martin Place)
23T4 Bondi Junction, Town Hall and return
324/325 City, Walsh Bay to Watsons Bay via Town Hall (Park St), Kings Cross, Edgecliff stations and return
333 City to Bondi Beach via Martin Place and Bondi Junction stations and return
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.
subtitle: Buses replace trains between Central and Bondi Junction

infoLinks.content:
Saturday 11 and Sunday 12 April  
  • Trains run to a changed timetable between Bankstown and Lidcombe, and between Bankstown and the City.
  • Buses replace T3 Liverpool & Inner West Line trains between Liverpool and Lidcombe
  • Saturday from 5am to 9am, trains run between Bankstown and Lidcombe only, every 30 minutes.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
